units: Kinn. I, 1 איזהו נדר … ואיזהו נ׳ וכ׳ a vow is called neder, when one says, I vow to dedicate a burnt-offering; ni’dabah, when one says, this animal is to be a burnt-offering. Ib. 3 בחובה ובנ׳ when an obligatory and a free-will sacrifice are mixed up.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 1:1">Men. I, 1</cite> <he>מנחת נ׳</he>, opp. to <he>מנחת חוטא</he>.

<cite ref="Menachot 2a:7">Ib. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>יהא נ׳</he> it will be a free-will offering (and the vow itself is not yet fulfilled); opp. <he>יהא נדר</he> it will be the fulfillment of his vow; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְדָבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 1:1">Ned. I, 1</cite> <he>כנִדְבוֹתָם</he> like their (the good men’s) free-will offerings or vows; a. fr.
